name: SURI: The Seventh Note
description:
About This Game

Journey Through Rhythm

Rhythm is life on the island of Suri.
When its harmony is broken, the land twists and turns to a darker pulse.

Play as Ajira, a young girl who ventures deep into the heart of a musical world gone wrong. Her journey begins as a simple act of hope, to find a rare fruit that could save her mother. But soon it becomes a battle to restore balance to rhythm itself.

Every platform, enemy, and escape sequence moves with the music.
Listen closely. Feel the pulse. The beat will guide you or break you.

Game Features

• Rhythm-Driven Action – Run, jump, and phase in sync with the soundtrack. The world reacts to your timing, and missing the beat means losing your flow.

• Cinematic Escape Sequences – Push your reflexes through handcrafted chases where gameplay and music fuse into one.

• Evolving Abilities – Unlock rhythm-infused powers that expand your movement and combat as you learn to master the beat.

• A World That Breathes Music – From quiet ruins to chaotic arenas, each level is composed like a song  with its own tempo, tone, and emotion.

A Game That Listens Back

In SURI: The Seventh Note, rhythm isn’t decoration — it’s the law of nature. Learn its patterns. Trust its timing. When you move with the beat, the island moves with you.
short_desc: A rhythm-action platformer where every move syncs to the music. Dash, jump, and escape through a mystical world shaped by rhythm to save your mother’s life. Rhythm was the life of the island of Suri, who will step up when its harmony is broken?
